description: This Java class implements a cache for device profiles in the Thingsboard platform, providing methods to get, put, and evict device profiles, with thread-safe fetching from a transport service.

classes.name: DefaultTransportDeviceProfileCache
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe cache for device profiles, fetching from transport service if not present.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves existing device profile or creates and caches a new one from proto.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a device profile in the cache.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a device profile from the cache by ID.

methods.name: getDeviceProfile
methods.description: Fetches device profile from transport service if not cached, with thread safety.
